senses.definition: n.pr.f. (daughter of oath? cf. אֱלִישֶׁ֫בַע) wife of Uriah 2 S 11:3 ψ 50:2; afterwords of David, & mother of Solomon 12:24 1 K 1:11, 15, 16, 31; 2:13, 18, 19; בַּת־שָׁ֑בַע 1 K 1:28; cf. also foll.
